meta.name: Frontend Product Builder Foundational Components
meta.description: Canonical primitive components used as the interaction and visual foundation of the product frontend.

Button.name: Button
Button.description: Canonical control for invoking an explicit user action with semantic priority, pending behavior, and accessible interaction.
capabilities: Invoke an explicit user action.
Communicate primary, secondary, neutral, or destructive action priority.
Prevent duplicate activation during pending operations.
Support visible-label and icon-only actions.

foundation.reason: Provides a composable accessible base that can be constrained through semantic variants and design tokens.

primary.intent: Advance the dominant task in the current region.
allowedUse: One dominant action in a page section.
prohibitedUse: Several competing actions in the same region.

secondary.intent: Expose an important supporting action without competing with the primary action.

prohibitedUse: Dominant form submission when a primary action exists.
Only call to action in a full empty state.

danger.intent: Communicate a destructive, revoking, disabling, or irreversible action.

link.intent: Render a button-like action with link-level visual emphasis when genuine navigation is not intended.
allowedUse: Local action embedded in supporting content.

sm.intent: Compact toolbar and dense operational action.

lg.intent: Prominent action in spacious and focused contexts.

icon.intent: Icon-only action with an explicit accessible name.

slots.name: leadingIcon
slots.description: Optional icon displayed before the visible label.
contentRestrictions: Decorative icons must be hidden from assistive technology.
Do not use an icon as the only label unless the icon size contract is selected.

slots.name: label
contentRestrictions: Use concise verb-first labels.
Do not use vague labels such as Confirmar when the outcome can be named.

slots.name: trailingIcon
slots.description: Optional directional or disclosure icon displayed after the label.
contentRestrictions: Use only when the icon communicates direction, disclosure, or external behavior.

props.name: variant
props.type: primary | secondary | outline | ghost | danger | link
restrictions: Do not select a variant only to obtain a preferred color.

props.name: size
restrictions: Consumers must not override control height through arbitrary classes.

props.name: loading
props.description: Indicates that the invoked action is pending and prevents duplicate activation.
restrictions: Loading does not replace mutation error handling.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Allows semantic composition with another element when supported by the foundation.
restrictions: Do not use asChild to create invalid button or link semantics.

spacingOwnership: Button owns spacing between icon and label.
The parent action group owns spacing between buttons.
composition.surfaceOwnership: Button owns its interactive surface according to the selected semantic variant.
rules: One region normally contains no more than one primary button.
A button must not be nested inside another interactive control.
Use genuine links for route navigation.

recipeCompatibility.notes: Only for approved global utilities.
Variant must reflect action hierarchy.
Bulk destructive actions require confirmation.
Submission uses one dominant primary action.
The selected human decision determines the dominant action.

notes: Pending behavior is received through props.
Mutation ownership remains with the feature or form.
The consumer callback owns the action side effect.

responsive.strategy: Preserve semantic priority while allowing labels and action groups to wrap through parent composition.
responsive.compact: May become full width when the owning form, authentication, or empty-state contract requires it.
responsive.medium: Uses content width and may wrap inside action groups.
responsive.wide: Uses content width and remains aligned by the owning layout.
responsive.ultrawide: Does not expand merely because more viewport width exists.
responsive.overflowPolicy: Button labels must not create page-level horizontal overflow.
responsive.zoomExpectation: Must remain operable at 200% text scaling and at least 125% browser zoom.

accessibility.semanticElement: button unless composed as a genuine semantic link
accessibility.accessibleName: Visible label or explicit accessible name for icon-only usage.
keyboard: Do not activate while disabled or loading.
focus: Preserve focus after recoverable action errors.
announcements: Meaningful pending state should be perceivable.
Action completion is announced by the owning workflow when required.
aria: Use aria-busy when the pending state requires announcement.
Prefer native disabled over aria-disabled when possible.
accessibility.colorIndependence: Destructive and warning meaning must also be communicated through label, icon, or surrounding context.

content.typical: A concise verb-first label with an optional icon.
content.maximum: A localized action label that may wrap only where the parent contract allows it.
content.wrapping: Avoid wrapping by using concise labels; allow controlled wrapping in compact full-width contexts.
content.truncation: Do not truncate critical action labels.
content.localization: Support substantial text expansion without fixed widths.
content.emptyBehavior: A button without an accessible name is invalid.
content.technicalContent: Technical identifiers must not be used as ordinary action labels.

browserScenarios: Primary and secondary actions in compact forms

Input.name: Input
Input.description: Canonical single-line input for textual, numeric, email, search, and other native input modes.
capabilities: Receive one line of user-entered data.
Expose native browser input behavior.
Communicate disabled, read-only, invalid, and focus states.

foundation.reason: Native input semantics provide browser, keyboard, validation, autofill, and assistive-technology behavior.

allowedUse: Numeric entry when native number behavior is appropriate.
prohibitedUse: Selection from a constrained option list.
Formatted monetary behavior without an approved composite.

props.name: type
props.description: Native input mode matching the expected value.
restrictions: Do not use type=number for identifiers or values with leading zeroes.

props.name: aria-invalid
restrictions: An invalid field also requires associated error content.

spacingOwnership: FormField owns spacing between label, input, help, and error.
composition.surfaceOwnership: Input owns its control surface and border.
rules: Compose ordinary form usage through FormField.
Placeholder text must not replace a visible label.
Input width is owned by the form layout.

recipeCompatibility.notes: Compose through FormField.
Credential fields require appropriate autocomplete attributes.
Ordinary search should use SearchInput rather than a bare Input.

notes: The owning form or feature determines controlled versus uncontrolled usage.
Do not copy a controlled value into local state without lifecycle analysis.

responsive.strategy: Follow the width assigned by the owning form or search layout.
responsive.compact: Normally fills the available field-group width.
responsive.medium: May use content-appropriate width inside approved field grids.
responsive.wide: Must not stretch indefinitely when expected content is short.
responsive.ultrawide: Remains constrained by the owning form recipe.
responsive.overflowPolicy: Must not exceed the parent container.
responsive.zoomExpectation: Label, value, help, and error must remain usable at 200% text scaling.

accessibility.accessibleName: Associated visible label supplied by FormField or explicit label element.
keyboard: Preserve browser autofill and editing shortcuts.
focus: Do not remove focus through preventDefault behavior.
announcements: Validation errors must be programmatically associated.
Required state must be exposed through form semantics.
aria: Use aria-describedby for help and error content.
accessibility.colorIndependence: Invalid and disabled states must not depend only on border color.

content.minimum: An empty editable value with an external label.
content.typical: One line of user-entered domain data.
content.maximum: Length defined by the feature schema and backend contract.
content.wrapping: Single line with native horizontal input behavior.
content.truncation: The editable value uses native input scrolling rather than visual ellipsis.
content.localization: Labels and help content are owned externally and must support expansion.
content.emptyBehavior: Empty value remains distinct from unavailable or read-only information.
content.technicalContent: Technical identifiers are permitted only in explicitly approved administrative or audit fields.

Textarea.name: Textarea
Textarea.description: Canonical multiline input for notes, rationale, descriptions, and other variable-length textual content.
capabilities: Receive multiline user-entered text.
Support validation, disabled, read-only, and focus states.
Resize according to approved content and layout policy.

foundation.reason: Native textarea semantics provide reliable editing, selection, keyboard, and assistive-technology behavior.

props.name: rows
props.description: Initial visible line count appropriate to expected content.
restrictions: Do not use a large fixed height to reserve empty space.
Expected content length must justify the value.

spacingOwnership: FormField owns label, help, and error spacing.
composition.surfaceOwnership: Textarea owns its editable control surface.
rules: Use through FormField in ordinary forms.
Do not apply fixed heights that clip enlarged text.
Character count belongs to an approved composite when required.

recipeCompatibility.notes: Use for variable-length textual input.
Human rationale must remain distinct from machine recommendation text.

notes: Owning form controls persistence and dirty state.

responsive.strategy: Fill the owning field width while preserving readable minimum height.
responsive.compact: Uses full field-group width and grows vertically.
responsive.wide: Remains constrained by the form container.
responsive.ultrawide: Does not stretch beyond the approved reading width.
responsive.overflowPolicy: Text wraps; the control must not create page-level horizontal overflow.
responsive.zoomExpectation: Must remain usable with enlarged text and 125% browser zoom.

keyboard: Preserve expected line-break and selection shortcuts.
announcements: Validation and character constraints must be associated when applicable.
aria: Use aria-describedby for help, count, and error content.
accessibility.colorIndependence: Invalid and read-only state must not depend only on color.

content.minimum: An empty multiline field with an associated label.
content.typical: Several sentences of notes, explanation, or rationale.
content.maximum: Length controlled by the feature schema and backend contract.
content.truncation: Editable text is not visually truncated.
content.localization: Labels, instructions, and validation messages support expansion.
content.emptyBehavior: Empty value remains distinguishable from unavailable information.
content.technicalContent: Raw logs or stack traces must not be entered or displayed through ordinary user workflows.

Checkbox.name: Checkbox
Checkbox.description: Canonical binary or indeterminate selection control used for independent choices and explicit acknowledgements.
capabilities: Represent checked, unchecked, and indeterminate states.
Allow keyboard and pointer selection.
Communicate disabled and invalid states.

foundation.reason: Provides accessible controlled and uncontrolled checkbox behavior including indeterminate state.

prohibitedUse: Mutually exclusive choice where RadioGroup is appropriate.

md.intent: Default checkbox with an adequate interactive target.

slots.name: indicator
contentRestrictions: State must also be exposed semantically.

props.name: checked
restrictions: Do not supply checked without an appropriate change handler in controlled usage.

prohibitedChildren: Visible label text inside the checkbox primitive
spacingOwnership: The checkbox-field composite owns spacing between control, label, help, and error.
rules: The visible label must activate the checkbox.
The checkbox primitive does not own descriptive content.
Indeterminate state must not be treated as checked submission without feature rules.

recipeCompatibility.notes: Use through a labeled field composition.
Selection count and select-all scope must be explicit.
Use only for independent acknowledgement or optional conditions.

notes: The owning form, table, or feature owns the selected value.

responsive.strategy: Maintain a usable target while the label wraps independently.
responsive.compact: Control remains aligned to the start of multiline labels.
responsive.ultrawide: Does not scale with viewport width.
responsive.overflowPolicy: The label wraps through the owning field composition.
responsive.zoomExpectation: The control and label must remain operable at 200% text scaling.

accessibility.accessibleName: Associated visible label or row-specific accessible label.
keyboard: Follow native or Radix checkbox interaction.
focus: Maintain logical order in table selection.
announcements: Checked and indeterminate state must be exposed.
Validation errors must be associated through the owning field.
aria: Use aria-describedby through the owning field when necessary.
accessibility.colorIndependence: Checked and indeterminate states use shape or icon in addition to color.

content.minimum: One binary choice with an accessible name.
content.typical: A checkbox paired with a concise visible label.
content.maximum: A localized multiline label with optional supporting help.
content.wrapping: Label wraps independently beside the control.
content.truncation: Do not truncate legal acknowledgement or critical permission labels.
content.emptyBehavior: A checkbox without an accessible name is invalid.
content.technicalContent: Backend Boolean property names must be translated into user-facing statements.

Select.name: Select
Select.description: Canonical single-selection popup control for choosing one value from a constrained option collection.
capabilities: Select one option from a constrained collection.
Support keyboard navigation and type-ahead behavior.
Communicate disabled, invalid, and open states.

foundation.reason: Provides accessible popup selection behavior, keyboard navigation, portals, and focus management.

allowedUse: Compact filter with a manageable option count.
prohibitedUse: Free text search across a large remote collection.

md.intent: Default form and filter selection size.

slots.name: trigger
slots.description: Control displaying the current selection and opening the popup.
contentRestrictions: Must expose an accessible name through the owning field.

slots.name: content
contentRestrictions: Do not render unrelated actions inside the option list.

slots.name: item
contentRestrictions: Every value requires a meaningful user-facing label.
Raw enum values must be mapped before rendering.

props.name: value
restrictions: User-facing labels must not be used as unstable persistence identifiers.

props.name: onValueChange
restrictions: The primitive does not persist the selection directly.

spacingOwnership: Select trigger owns internal value and indicator spacing.
FormField owns external label and error spacing.
composition.surfaceOwnership: Trigger owns a control surface; content owns an elevated popup surface.
rules: Use Combobox rather than Select for large searchable remote collections.
Option order must follow product logic.
Popup width must support realistic labels without creating viewport overflow.

recipeCompatibility.notes: Use for constrained single selection.
Use for compact filters, sorting, or page size.
Raw permission and backend enum values must be mapped.

notes: The owning form, feature, or URL filter controls the selected value.
The foundation manages popup focus and option scrolling.

responsive.strategy: Use the width assigned by the owning form while constraining popup content to the viewport.
responsive.compact: Trigger normally fills the available field width; popup remains viewport constrained.
responsive.wide: Uses form or filter width rather than equal-width expansion.
responsive.ultrawide: Does not stretch with unused page width.
responsive.overflowPolicy: Long option labels wrap or truncate according to the approved content contract; popup must remain inside the viewport.
responsive.zoomExpectation: Trigger and popup must remain operable at 200% text scaling.

accessibility.semanticElement: combobox and listbox semantics provided by Radix Select
accessibility.accessibleName: Visible associated label or explicit accessible label.
keyboard: Open with Enter, Space, ArrowDown, or ArrowUp according to foundation behavior.
focus: Popup restores focus to the trigger on close.
announcements: Selected option and expanded state are exposed.
Validation errors are associated through the owning field.
accessibility.colorIndependence: Selected and disabled options require non-color indicators.

content.minimum: One selected value or an explicit unselected prompt.
content.typical: A constrained collection of concise labeled options.
content.maximum: A manageable option collection whose labels remain readable in the popup.
content.wrapping: Trigger and option wrapping follow the approved field contract.
content.truncation: Critical option distinctions must not be lost through truncation.
content.localization: Support expanded labels without fixed popup width assumptions.
content.emptyBehavior: An empty option collection requires a disabled or unavailable composite state.
content.technicalContent: Raw enum keys must be translated before rendering.

Dialog.name: Dialog
Dialog.description: Canonical modal overlay for focused tasks that temporarily interrupt the underlying interface and require explicit focus management.
capabilities: Present a focused modal task.
Trap focus while open.
Restore focus after dismissal.
Provide title, description, content, and action regions.

foundation.reason: Provides accessible modal semantics, focus trapping, portals, dismissal, and restoration behavior.

default.intent: Focused modal task or contextual workflow.

sm.intent: Short confirmation or compact focused content.

allowedUse: Multi-section modal content with explicit height management.

slots.name: title
slots.description: Visible title naming the modal task.
contentRestrictions: Use concise task-oriented text.

slots.name: description
slots.description: Optional explanation of task impact or required context.
contentRestrictions: Do not place critical content only in inaccessible helper text.

slots.name: content
contentRestrictions: Avoid complete route-level experiences.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Action region for confirmation, cancellation, or workflow controls.
contentRestrictions: One dominant action.
Destructive actions require semantic danger treatment.

props.name: open
restrictions: The consumer must handle state changes when controlled.

props.name: onOpenChange
restrictions: Do not suppress close behavior without a documented workflow reason.

prohibitedParents: Another modal Dialog without an approved nested workflow
spacingOwnership: DialogHeader owns title and description spacing.
DialogFooter owns action spacing and alignment.
composition.surfaceOwnership: Dialog owns overlay and elevated modal surfaces.
rules: Every dialog requires an accessible title.
The underlying interface is inert while a modal dialog is open.
Dialog height must respect the viewport.
Ordinary error messages should not open a modal automatically.

recipeCompatibility.notes: Dialog portals belong in the global feedback layer.
Use for unsaved changes, conflicts, or short supporting workflows.
Sensitive confirmations may require reauthentication.
Use for final confirmation or stale conflict resolution.

notes: Feature composites own workflow and mutation state.
The primitive owns only foundation-level open-state behavior when uncontrolled.
Opening traps focus and may lock background scrolling.
Closing restores focus to the trigger or approved target.

responsive.strategy: Constrain width and height by viewport while preserving task clarity and safe scrolling.
responsive.compact: May use near-full-width or full-height presentation with safe margins.
responsive.wide: Centered modal using approved size variant.
responsive.ultrawide: Remains constrained and does not scale with the viewport.
responsive.overflowPolicy: Dialog content may scroll internally only when height exceeds the viewport; actions remain accessible.
responsive.zoomExpectation: Must remain operable at 200% text scaling without inaccessible content or actions.

accessibility.semanticElement: dialog with aria-modal semantics provided by Radix
keyboard: Close with Escape when dismissal is allowed.
Tab and Shift+Tab remain inside the modal.
focus: Move focus to the appropriate initial element.
announcements: Title and description are announced when the dialog opens.
Pending and error states inside the dialog remain perceivable.
aria: Do not remove the title solely for visual reasons.
accessibility.colorIndependence: Destructive, warning, and pending state must not depend only on color.

content.minimum: A title and focused task content.
content.typical: Title, optional description, concise content, and action footer.
content.maximum: A bounded complex workflow whose height and reading order remain manageable.
content.wrapping: Titles, descriptions, content, and actions wrap within the viewport.
content.truncation: Do not truncate critical impact descriptions or action labels.
content.localization: Support expanded titles and buttons without fixed-height assumptions.
content.emptyBehavior: A dialog without meaningful content is invalid.
content.technicalContent: Raw errors, tokens, stack traces, and implementation details are prohibited.

DropdownMenu.name: DropdownMenu
DropdownMenu.description: Canonical contextual menu for grouping low-frequency actions associated with a trigger, row, entity, or toolbar.
capabilities: Expose a contextual action collection.
Move low-frequency actions out of primary visual hierarchy.
Support keyboard navigation, grouping, disabled items, and submenus.

foundation.reason: Provides accessible menu semantics, keyboard navigation, portals, groups, separators, and submenus.

slots.name: trigger
contentRestrictions: Icon-only triggers require an accessible name.

slots.name: content
contentRestrictions: Menu content contains menu items and structural menu elements.

slots.name: item
contentRestrictions: Item labels use action language.
Destructive actions require danger semantics and separation.

spacingOwnership: Menu content owns internal item spacing.
The trigger parent owns external spacing.
composition.surfaceOwnership: DropdownMenu owns an elevated popup surface.
rules: The main task must not be hidden in overflow.
Destructive actions appear after a separator or inside an explicit danger group.
Menu items must not be nested interactive components.

recipeCompatibility.notes: Use for user and low-frequency global utilities.
Exports and configuration may move to overflow.
Row actions must remain subordinate to row content.
Audit and low-frequency utilities may move to overflow.

notes: Feature composition provides action callbacks and eligibility.
The foundation manages focus and viewport collision.

responsive.strategy: Keep the trigger compact while constraining menu content to the viewport.
responsive.compact: Menu may align to a safe viewport edge or use a sheet only when the action set is unusually complex.
responsive.medium: Popup menu aligned to the trigger.
responsive.overflowPolicy: Long labels wrap or truncate only when full meaning remains accessible.
responsive.zoomExpectation: Must remain keyboard operable and viewport constrained at 200% text scaling.

accessibility.semanticElement: menu semantics provided by Radix DropdownMenu
accessibility.accessibleName: Trigger accessible name and visible item labels.
keyboard: Open with Enter, Space, or ArrowDown.
focus: Move focus into the menu on open.
Restore focus to the trigger on close.
announcements: Expanded state, disabled items, and checked items are exposed.
accessibility.colorIndependence: Destructive, checked, and disabled states use text, icons, or semantics in addition to color.

content.minimum: One contextual action and an accessible trigger.
content.maximum: A constrained action list; large capability navigation requires another pattern.
content.wrapping: Item labels may wrap when necessary.
content.truncation: Do not truncate actions whose consequences would become ambiguous.
content.localization: Menu width supports expanded localized labels.
content.emptyBehavior: A menu with no eligible items must not open or must present an explicit unavailable state.
content.technicalContent: Raw permission names and internal action identifiers are prohibited.

Tooltip.name: Tooltip
Tooltip.description: Canonical supplementary label or concise clarification displayed for hover and keyboard focus without containing essential interactive content.
capabilities: Provide a concise supplementary label.
Expose the meaning of an icon-only control.
Clarify nonessential abbreviated content.

foundation.reason: Provides keyboard-focus and hover behavior, portals, timing, and accessible description relationships.

prohibitedUse: Information required to complete a task.

slots.name: trigger
slots.description: Element that receives hover or focus.
contentRestrictions: The trigger remains independently understandable when possible.

slots.name: content
contentRestrictions: Do not include form controls or critical actions.

composition.surfaceOwnership: Tooltip owns a small elevated surface.
rules: Essential information must remain available without hover.
Tooltip content must also appear on keyboard focus.
Do not place an information icon beside every label.

recipeCompatibility.notes: Useful for compact navigation icons.
May expose full secondary values but must not hide critical table data.
Essential form help must use visible help text or disclosure.

responsive.strategy: Position near the trigger while respecting viewport collision.
responsive.compact: Must not be the only way touch users access important information.
responsive.medium: Appears near the focused or hovered trigger.
responsive.wide: Appears near the focused or hovered trigger.
responsive.overflowPolicy: Content wraps inside a constrained maximum width.
responsive.zoomExpectation: Must remain readable and viewport constrained at enlarged text sizes.

accessibility.accessibleName: Tooltip content supplements the trigger's accessible description.
keyboard: Dismiss with Escape according to foundation behavior.
focus: Tooltip content does not receive focus.
announcements: Content is exposed as a description where appropriate.

content.typical: A short label or one-sentence clarification.
content.maximum: Two short sentences; longer content requires another pattern.
content.localization: Support localized expansion while preserving concise content.
content.emptyBehavior: Do not render an empty tooltip.
content.technicalContent: Technical definitions are permitted only when they are appropriate to the target user.

Badge.name: Badge
Badge.description: Canonical compact non-interactive label for status, category, scope, or small metadata.
capabilities: Present a concise status or category label.
Communicate semantic tone through token-backed variants.
Support icons and short text without behaving as an action.

foundation.reason: Provides a concise primitive that can be constrained to semantic non-interactive status variants.

success.intent: Communicate completed, healthy, or successful state.

warning.intent: Communicate attention or caution without immediate destructive severity.

danger.intent: Communicate failed, blocked, expired, or materially risky state.

sm.intent: Compact metadata and dense table state.

slots.name: icon
contentRestrictions: Icon meaning must match the semantic variant.

slots.name: label
slots.description: Visible concise status or category label.
contentRestrictions: Use user-facing terminology.

props.name: variant
restrictions: Do not select based only on preferred color.

prohibitedParents: Button when the badge is only decorative
spacingOwnership: Badge owns spacing between optional icon and label.
composition.surfaceOwnership: Badge owns its compact semantic surface.
rules: Badge is non-interactive by default.
Use StatusBadge when domain mapping and accessibility labels are required.
Do not display long sentences inside badges.

recipeCompatibility.notes: Use for concise status, not complete alert content.
Domain statuses should normally use StatusBadge.
Use concise labels.

responsive.strategy: Remain compact while allowing concise text wrapping where unavoidable.
responsive.compact: May wrap to a second line when a localized label requires it.
responsive.overflowPolicy: Do not create page overflow; long labels require a different presentation.
responsive.zoomExpectation: Must remain legible at 200% text scaling.

accessibility.semanticElement: span or appropriate non-interactive text element
accessibility.accessibleName: Visible label, optionally supplemented by hidden context.
focus: No focus behavior unless the owning composite is interactive.
announcements: Dynamic critical changes require announcement through the owning status component.
aria: Avoid unnecessary roles on static badges.
accessibility.colorIndependence: Semantic state is expressed through text and optionally icon in addition to color.

content.typical: One to three words describing a status or category.
content.maximum: A short localized phrase; sentences require another component.
content.wrapping: Prefer one line; allow controlled wrapping.
content.truncation: Do not truncate when the remaining label becomes ambiguous.
content.localization: Support text expansion without fixed pill width.
content.emptyBehavior: Do not render an empty badge.
content.technicalContent: Raw enum keys and identifiers are prohibited.

Skeleton.name: Skeleton
Skeleton.description: Canonical non-interactive placeholder used to preserve expected layout geometry during initial loading.
capabilities: Represent pending visual structure.
Reduce layout shift during initial loading.
Compose route-, region-, and component-shaped loading states.

foundation.reason: Provides a minimal token-backed primitive for composing realistic loading structures.

prohibitedUse: Indeterminate long-running process without status text.

spacingOwnership: The owning loading composition controls spacing between skeleton shapes.
composition.surfaceOwnership: Skeleton owns only its placeholder shape.
rules: Skeleton dimensions approximate eventual content.
Different regions use different realistic skeleton structures.
Background refresh preserves populated content instead of replacing it with skeletons.

recipeCompatibility.notes: Use region-specific shapes.
Use row- and column-shaped table skeletons.
Use before authoritative edit values are available.

notes: The owning query or screen determines when the skeleton renders.

responsive.strategy: Mirror the responsive geometry of the eventual component.
responsive.ultrawide: Does not create additional placeholder regions absent from final content.
responsive.overflowPolicy: Must not create overflow beyond the eventual component contract.
responsive.zoomExpectation: Must not hide progress meaning from assistive technology.

accessibility.semanticElement: decorative element hidden from assistive technology unless wrapped by a labeled loading region
accessibility.accessibleName: Provided by the owning LoadingState rather than individual skeleton shapes.
announcements: The owning loading region communicates pending state when required.
aria: Hide individual decorative skeleton shapes from assistive technology.
accessibility.colorIndependence: Loading meaning is communicated by the owning status text or busy state, not only animation.
accessibility.contrastTarget: Non-text contrast appropriate to the approved loading treatment.

content.minimum: One placeholder shape inside a labeled loading composition.
content.maximum: Only enough placeholders to communicate the expected structure.
content.localization: Skeleton geometry must tolerate eventual localized expansion.
content.emptyBehavior: Do not render a zero-size skeleton.

checks.description: The foundational component catalog must validate against the component catalog schema.
checks.remediation: Correct invalid or missing component catalog fields.

checks.description: Foundational component IDs, names, implementations, and public imports must be unique.
Primitive components must not import feature, entity, route, query, permission, or transport modules.
checks.remediation: Move domain and data behavior to the appropriate composite or feature owner.

checks.description: Stable interactive primitives must have keyboard, focus, accessible-name, disabled, and pending-state coverage where applicable.
checks.remediation: Create or correct the required component tests.

checks.description: Potential primitive duplicates and suspicious names require review.
checks.remediation: Reuse, merge, remove, or document the semantic difference.
